title: MobLand Adds Gregg Sulkin to Its Season 3 Cast
excerpt:
Paramount+ has begun filming the crime drama’s third season.
Gregg Sulkin joins in a recurring role that remains undisclosed.
body_md:
British actor Gregg Sulkin, known for Wizards of Waverly Place and The Forsytes, is the latest addition to MobLand. He will appear in a recurring role, although the character’s identity and relationship to the central crime family have not been revealed.

Season three continues from the second-season finale, which left the Harrigans facing a serious threat from rival gangster Frankie Cooper, played by Johnny Flynn. Tom Hardy, Pierce Brosnan and Helen Mirren are confirmed to return. Paramount has not disclosed the full roster of returning performers.

The renewal followed reported tensions between Hardy and showrunner Jez Butterworth. A London meeting involving the pair and executive producer David C. Glasser preceded Paramount’s confirmation of the third season in September 2026. The details of their discussions have not been made public.

The executive producing team includes Guy Ritchie, Butterworth, Hardy and Glasser, with production involving Paramount Television Studios and 101 Studios. Season two featured performers including Paddy Considine, Joanne Froggatt, Toby Jones and Janet McTeer, but their previous involvement should not be mistaken for confirmation of their return.

Sulkin’s other credits include The Kollective, The Six Triple Eight and World on Fire. He also recently reprised Mason Greyback for the conclusion of Wizards Beyond Waverly Place. His addition to MobLand is confirmed, but whether he plays an ally or an adversary remains unknown. No third-season premiere date was provided in the casting report.
